{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "a141799decc1ece52d876b550bdbafbba00e91724e02e44cfacf8cde80bda6c4",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality between two terms of the same type or sort.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses equality of current values, equality of advance values, and equality of advance with the composite function. The last equality is equivalent to agreement at every history.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification: there is a term satisfying the specified predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Quantifies a function step from the range of current to NextData. Within the range definition, it also requires a history whose current value equals the specified value.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "Function.comp",
      "meaning": "Function composition, defined by (f ∘ g)(x) = f(g(x)).",
      "effect_on_target": "The composite first sends a history to its current value regarded as an element of the range, and then applies step.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "Iff",
      "meaning": "Logical equivalence: each of the two propositions implies the other.",
      "effect_on_target": "Asserts both that constancy of advance on fibers of current implies the factorization and that the factorization implies this constancy.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "Set.Elem",
      "meaning": "The subtype of elements of a given set, consisting of an underlying value together with a proof of membership.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts the domain of step to current values that occur for some history. Its inputs contain membership proofs, not chosen histories.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "Set.range",
      "meaning": "The range of f is the set of values x for which there exists an input y with f(y) = x.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines the domain of step as precisely the attained values of current.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Set.rangeFactorization",
      "meaning": "The function sending each input i to f(i) equipped with a proof that f(i) belongs to the range of f.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the canonical map from History to the range subtype of current used in the factorization equation.",
      "status": "understood"
    }
  ],
  "translation": {
    "binders": [
      "Universally quantify History : Sort u_1, CurrentData : Type u_2, and NextData : Sort u_3.",
      "Universally quantify functions current : History → CurrentData and advance : History → NextData.",
      "On the left side, universally quantify two histories history₁ and history₂.",
      "On the right side, existentially quantify step : R → NextData, where R is the subtype of values in the range of current. This witness is chosen for the fixed types and functions and must work for every history."
    ],
    "hypotheses": [
      "There are no additional global hypotheses.",
      "Within the left-hand proposition, equality current(history₁) = current(history₂) is the premise of an implication."
    ],
    "conclusions": [
      "The following are equivalent: (1) for every history₁ and history₂, current(history₁) = current(history₂) implies advance(history₁) = advance(history₂); (2) there exists step : R → NextData such that advance = step ∘ q, where q(h) is current(h) equipped with its range-membership proof."
    ],
    "mathematical_definitions": [
      "R = {c : CurrentData | there exists h : History such that current(h) = c}, regarded as a subtype.",
      "q : History → R is defined by q(h) = ⟨current(h), proof that current(h) belongs to the range of current⟩.",
      "The equation advance = step ∘ q is equivalently the assertion that advance(h) = step(q(h)) for every h : History.",
      "Constancy on fibers of current means that any two histories with the same current value have the same advance value."
    ],
    "proposition_plain_english": "For arbitrary sorts History and NextData, an arbitrary type CurrentData, and arbitrary functions current : History → CurrentData and advance : History → NextData, advance is constant on each fiber of current if and only if there exists a function from the attained current values to NextData whose composition with the canonical map sending each history to its attained current value equals advance."
  },
  "restrictions_and_vacuity_risks": [
    "The function step is defined only on the range of current; the proposition does not assert an extension to all of CurrentData.",
    "No nonemptiness assumption is imposed. If History is empty, the left side holds vacuously, the range is empty, and the right side holds using the empty-domain function.",
    "The given functions constrain possible empty types: if History is inhabited, both CurrentData and NextData must be inhabited.",
    "History and NextData are arbitrary sorts and may be propositions; CurrentData is a type. No additional mathematical structure is assumed.",
    "The existential witness is one function that works simultaneously for all histories. No computable construction or algorithm for obtaining it is asserted.",
    "Uniqueness of step is not explicitly asserted, although it follows because the canonical map onto the range is surjective.",
    "The names current and advance impose no temporal, dynamical, or causal semantics. The proposition asserts only a factorization of functions, with no iteration, ordering of histories, or transition relation."
  ],
  "ambiguities": []
}
